events.title: Clinical Study Protocol Writing Workshop
events.venue: Ahmedabad Management Association (AMA), Atira Campus, Dr. Vikram Sarabhai Marg, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380009
events.summary: A full-day, hands-on, in-person workshop: understanding ICH E6 (R3) and M11, and the QbD and CtQ principles, for phase I to IV clinical trials, BA/BE studies, RWE and investigator-initiated study protocols.
highlights: In-depth training based on ICH E6 (R3), M11 and TransCelerate's Common Protocol Template, and other protocol guidance
An overview of QbD and CtQ concepts and their relevance to protocol drafting
Protocol templates: structure, content, and adaptation for phase I to IV clinical trials, BA/BE, RWE, investigator-initiated and other study designs
Concept sheet to protocol: a step-by-step approach to drafting and finalisation
Hands-on assignments on key protocol sections, tailored to various study designs
Exploring AI/ML automation in protocol writing
attend: Clinical trial (phase I to IV) protocol writing teams
BA/BE and RWE study writing teams
Medical affairs teams and clinical operations professionals
Academics and students interested in protocol writing

fee.earlyNote: ₹5,500 plus 18% GST, all inclusive, for the first 15 paid registrations
fee.group: Group discounts for four or more participants from the same organisation
fee.covers: Course content, assignment workbooks, lunch and refreshments; a certificate for every participant
